notes: No commit (plan stop rule: wiring a red journey into the required e2e-backend-ready check would make it permanently red). Unblock needs a registration code-owner or data/privilege decision (drop c from the row lock, or change the privilege class). Prepared wiring kept as lane evidence (seed SQL, harness E2E_PLAYWRIGHT_PACKAGE patch, logs); not committed. PR follow-up (registration/data owner): record the createIdempotent FOR KEY SHARE OF i, c vs append_only admission_form_configurations privilege conflict as its own ledger finding; public submit returns HTTP 500 on databases provisioned by the apply-sql privilege sync.
